hero.title: Build & Scale Your Next SaaS with
hero.subtitle: A full-stack, enterprise-grade Next.js 16 starter equipped with Better Auth, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, bilingual Arabic RTL & English LTR, and a comprehensive Admin Portal.

features.title: Engineered for Rapid SaaS Development
features.subtitle: Stop reinventing the wheel. Start with a solid, modular foundation that scales from MVP to production.

auth.title: Authentication & RBAC
auth.description: Better Auth with email/password, session management, rate limiting, and role-based guards.

database.title: PostgreSQL & Drizzle ORM
database.description: Type-safe database schema with zero-lock baseline migrations, seeder utilities, and connection pooling.

bilingual.title: Bilingual RTL & LTR
bilingual.description: First-class Arabic RTL and English LTR localization powered by next-intl with automated locale routing.

admin.title: Complete Admin Portal
admin.description: Manage users, inspect system analytics, configure application settings, publish blogs, and send announcements.

architecture.title: Layered Clean Architecture
architecture.description: Strict modular structure (Route Handler → Guard → Controller → Service → Repository → DTO/Zod).

notifications.title: Email & Web Push
notifications.description: Transactional emails via Resend/SMTP, Web Push FCM notifications, and built-in newsletter engine.

cta.title: Ready to Ship Your Next Product?
cta.subtitle: Clone this template, add your domain logic, and launch your SaaS with full confidence.
